---
name: research-documentation
description: Write or revise HypnoTrust documentation (README, model card, protocol) in precise scientific English without adding unsupported claims or altering recorded results.
---

# Research documentation

- Preserve measured values exactly; add source, version, protocol and aggregation for each.
- Use calibrated language: proof of concept, not clinically validated, not state of the art.
- Keep participants, recordings and epochs distinct.
- State limitations plainly (small development cohort, Subject 9 history, missing artifacts, unrecorded original environment).
- Cite only sources that were checked (title, year, DOI); never fabricate references.
- Do not delete original experimental records; mark superseded text instead.
